quests.sampleAnswer: I'd recommend the open street with wide pavements. The covered arcade is sheltered, but the aisles are narrow and crowded, so a large dog would have little room. The two meet at the central square, so you could see both.

quests.instruction: Final task: give a complete, elite description of this park in ten to twelve sentences. Include an overview, priorities, layout, people and actions, a comparison, a sequence, and a closing summary. Lead with the group in the center.
quests.hint: Plan your order before you speak: first point, layout, people, comparison, sequence, summary.
quests.explanation: The capstone asks for everything in the course in one cohesive spoken description: priority, layout, people and actions, comparison, sequence, and summary.
quests.sceneText: City Park|picnickers on the lawn|musicians on the bandstand|skaters on the paved path
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a city park on a sunny Sunday afternoon, and the first thing I'd point out is the lawn in the center, which is covered with picnickers on blankets. Most of them are sitting in small groups, some eating and some playing cards, and a few children are running between the blankets. To the right, the bandstand is the focal point: three musicians are playing there, and a small crowd is standing in a half circle. Compared with the lawn, the bandstand area is more tightly packed, because people are standing instead of spreading out. Along the paved path in the foreground, skaters and cyclists are moving in both directions, with the skaters keeping to the left. In the background, a fountain sprays water in front of tall trees, and people are queuing at an ice cream cart next to it. A sequence is visible along the path: first the skaters, then the picnic lawn, and finally the bandstand. At the far end, a group of people is leaving through an arched gate. Overall, the park is lively, but each area has its own pace: calm on the lawn, energetic on the path, and attentive at the bandstand.
keyVocabulary: the first thing I'd point out

quests.instruction: Final task: give a complete, elite description of this fairground in ten to twelve sentences. Include an overview, priorities, layout, people and actions, a comparison, a sequence, and a closing summary. Give special attention to the queues.
quests.hint: Lead with the carousel, then the edges, the people, a comparison, a sequence, and a summary.
quests.explanation: The capstone combines every skill: the learner organizes a dense scene and speaks about it in cohesive, natural language.
quests.sceneText: Seaside Fairground at Dusk|brightly lit carousel|food stands along the edge|crowd gathering near the stage
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a seaside fairground at dusk, and the first thing you notice is the carousel in the center, with its rows of lights just coming on. Children and adults are riding painted horses, while others wait behind a rope with tickets in their hands. Along the edge, food stands are lined up, and the queues are different lengths: the popcorn stand has a short line, whereas the fried dough stand has a long one. In the foreground, a couple is sharing a paper cone of chips, and a boy is holding a balloon on a string. On the left, a small stage has a crowd gathering, but it's less packed than the carousel area. In the background, the sea is visible beyond the railing, with a few small boats near the horizon. A sequence is visible: first the ticket booth, then the rope line, then the carousel itself. People in matching shirts are walking along the stands, carrying boxes. Overall, the fair is busy and well organized, with a clear flow from the entrance to the rides.
acceptedSynonyms: food stands,stands along the edge,food stalls
crowd,crowd near the stage,people near the stage

Below them, long tables run down the middle, with lanterns every meter or so, and people are sitting on both sides, passing bowls. In the foreground, children are crouching to look at a basket of apples, while a woman is explaining something to them. On the left, musicians are playing in the corner, and a few couples are dancing in front of them. Compared with the tables, the dance area is smaller but livelier. In the background, wide doors are open and show an orchard. A sequence is visible: first the food at the entrance, then the tables, then the music. At the far end, a few people are carrying empty trays back toward a counter. Overall, the barn is busy, with everything arranged so that people move from the food to the music.
options: Dried flowers hanging from the beams
quests.correctAnswer: Dried flowers hanging from the beams
keyVocabulary: the first thing I'd point out
